prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/coredns/SKILL.md - Each node has local cache at link-local IP 169.254.20.10

prompts.prompt: Since which Kubernetes version has CoreDNS been the default cluster DNS server, replacing kube-dns? Answer concisely.
